references.text: Schism (σχίσμα) among the people regarding Jesus' identity, with some believing He was a prophet and others that He was a deceiver.
A similar division among the religious leaders concerning Jesus, as they asked: "How can a sinner perform such signs?"
The council's decision to kill Jesus to prevent the entire nation from perishing, in response to the words He spoke.
Description of a deeper split where many believed in Jesus but did not confess it for fear of being expelled from the synagogue.
